Functions.Name: Sat_MemClause
Functions.Original: static inline clause *  Sat_MemClause( Sat_Mem_t * p, int i, int k ) { assert( k ); return (clause *)(p->pPages[i] + k);         }

Functions.Name: Sat_MemClauseHand
Functions.Original: static inline clause *  Sat_MemClauseHand( Sat_Mem_t * p, cla h )    { return h ? Sat_MemClause( p, Sat_MemHandPage(p, h), Sat_MemHandShift(p, h) ) : NULL;                  }

Functions.Name: Sat_MemEntryNum

Functions.Name: Sat_MemHand
Functions.Original: static inline cla       Sat_MemHand( Sat_Mem_t * p, int i, int k )   { return (i << p->nPageSize) | k;                                                                       }
Functions.Draft: func Sat_MemHand(p *Sat_Mem_t, i int32, k int32) cla { return (i << p.nPageSize) | k;                                                                       }

Functions.Name: Sat_MemHandCurrent
Functions.Original: static inline cla       Sat_MemHandCurrent( Sat_Mem_t * p, int lrn ) { return (p->iPage[lrn] << p->nPageSize) | Sat_MemLimit( p->pPages[p->iPage[lrn]] );                    }
Functions.Draft: func Sat_MemHandCurrent(p *Sat_Mem_t, lrn int32) cla { return (p.iPage[lrn] << p.nPageSize) | Sat_MemLimit( p.pPages[p.iPage[lrn]] );                    }

Functions.Name: Sat_MemClauseUsed
Functions.Original: static inline int       Sat_MemClauseUsed( Sat_Mem_t * p, cla h )    { return h < p->BookMarkH[(h & p->uLearnedMask) > 0];                                                   }
Functions.Draft: func Sat_MemClauseUsed(p *Sat_Mem_t, h cla) int32 { return h < p.BookMarkH[(h & p.uLearnedMask) > 0];                                                   }

Functions.Name: Sat_MemMemoryHand
Functions.Original: static inline double    Sat_MemMemoryHand( Sat_Mem_t * p, cla h )    { return 1.0 * ((Sat_MemHandPage(p, h) + 2)/2 * (1 << (p->nPageSize+2)) + Sat_MemHandShift(p, h) * 4);  }
Functions.Draft: func Sat_MemMemoryHand(p *Sat_Mem_t, h cla) float64 { return 1.0 * ((Sat_MemHandPage(p, h) + 2)/2 * (1 << (p.nPageSize+2)) + Sat_MemHandShift(p, h) * 4);  }

Functions.Name: Sat_MemMemoryUsed
Functions.Original: static inline double    Sat_MemMemoryUsed( Sat_Mem_t * p, int lrn )  { return Sat_MemMemoryHand( p, Sat_MemHandCurrent(p, lrn) );                                            }
Functions.Draft: func Sat_MemMemoryUsed(p *Sat_Mem_t, lrn int32) float64 { return Sat_MemMemoryHand( p, Sat_MemHandCurrent(p, lrn) );                                            }

Functions.Name: Sat_MemMemoryAllUsed
Functions.Original: static inline double    Sat_MemMemoryAllUsed( Sat_Mem_t * p )        { return Sat_MemMemoryUsed( p, 0 ) + Sat_MemMemoryUsed( p, 1 );                                         }
Functions.Draft: func Sat_MemMemoryAllUsed(p *Sat_Mem_t) float64 { return Sat_MemMemoryUsed( p, 0 ) + Sat_MemMemoryUsed( p, 1 );                                         }

Functions.Name: Sat_MemMemoryAll
Functions.Original: static inline double    Sat_MemMemoryAll( Sat_Mem_t * p )            { return 1.0 * (p->iPage[0] + p->iPage[1] + 2) * (1 << (p->nPageSize+2));                               }
Functions.Draft: func Sat_MemMemoryAll(p *Sat_Mem_t) float64 { return 1.0 * (p.iPage[0] + p.iPage[1] + 2) * (1 << (p.nPageSize+2));                               }
